CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[KOL_TwrMagZasob] @twrkod varchar(40),@magkod varchar(5),@cwart varchar(40) AS BEGIN
declare @cn int select @cn=twr_ccknumer from cdn.twrkarty where twr_kod=@twrkod declare @tab table (polozenie varchar(24),ilosc decimal(15,4),cecha varchar(255),mgaid int) declare @tpaid int declare @cecha varchar(255) declare @magnumer int select @magnumer=mag_gidnumer from cdn.magazyny where mag_kod=@magkod declare adresy cursor fast_forward read_only for select tpa_id,tpa_cecha from cdn.twrpartie where tpa_ccknumer in (0,@cn) and tpa_twrnumer in (select twr_gidnumer from cdn.twrkarty where twr_kod=@twrkod) open adresy fetch next from adresy into @tpaid,@cecha while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin insert into @tab SELECT polozenie,zas_ilosc,@cecha,zas_mgaid FROM [CDN].[PobierzListeAdresowDoWydaniaTowaru] (@tpaid,@magnumer,100000) left join ( select [CDN].[PobierzMagAdres] (mga_id)as polozenie,mga_id from cdn.magobszary join cdn.magadresy on MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId where mgo_magnumer=@magnumer ) m on zas_mgaid=m.mga_id fetch next from adresy into @tpaid,@cecha end close adresy deallocate adresy select * from @tab where cecha=@cwart END
